scheduled.title: Kitchen fire
scheduled.text: A grease fire in a kitchen extraction duct spread into the ceiling void. The building was evacuated; two staff were treated for smoke inhalation and the restaurant is closed for repairs.
scheduled.mitigated_text: Because duct cleaning had been enforced, the fire was contained in the duct by the suppression system and the kitchen reopened within a day.

scheduled.title: Account compromise via phishing
scheduled.text: An attacker used credentials harvested in a phishing campaign to access a finance mailbox and attempt fraudulent invoices.
scheduled.mitigated_text: Multi-factor authentication blocked the attacker's login; only a password reset was needed.

scheduled.title: Critical supplier enters insolvency
scheduled.text: A single-source supplier stopped trading without warning. Emergency replacement supply costs 40% more and some services are disrupted.
scheduled.mitigated_text: The qualified second supplier took over within 48 hours, limiting disruption.

scheduled.title: Regulator issues a formal findings letter
scheduled.text: The regulator identified a significant gap and requires a remediation plan within 30 days, with possible enforcement action.
scheduled.mitigated_text: Because the gap was already being remediated with a documented plan, the regulator accepted the plan without further action.

scheduled.title: Supplier impersonation fraud
scheduled.text: A payment was redirected to a fraudster after an emailed request to change bank details.
scheduled.mitigated_text: The call-back control caught the fraudulent request before payment.

scheduled.title: Key executive resigns
scheduled.text: A key leader resigned to join a competitor, taking critical knowledge and relationships.
scheduled.mitigated_text: The documented succession plan meant an interim successor stepped in immediately.

scheduled.title: Transformation programme overrun confirmed
scheduled.text: The programme is now forecast at 38% over budget and seven months late.
scheduled.mitigated_text: Because the programme had been re-baselined early, the overrun was contained and expectations reset in time.

scheduled.title: Story goes viral
scheduled.text: A customer's video of a service failure spread widely and national media ran the story.
scheduled.mitigated_text: The agreed crisis communications protocol produced a fast, credible response and the story faded within days.

scheduled.title: Liquidity squeeze
scheduled.text: A delayed customer payment coincided with the facility renewal, pushing cash close to the covenant minimum.
scheduled.mitigated_text: The pre-agreed liquidity contingency plan released cash quickly and the covenant was not breached.

scheduled.title: Ransomware attack
scheduled.text: Ransomware encrypted several servers. Operations ran on manual workarounds while systems were rebuilt.
scheduled.mitigated_text: Clean offline backups allowed restoration in under two days without paying a ransom.

scheduled.title: Serious injury
scheduled.text: A worker was seriously injured in an incident that had been preceded by several near misses.
scheduled.mitigated_text: Closed safety actions meant the hazard had been guarded; the incident was a minor near miss instead.

scheduled.title: Staff survey reveals fear of speaking up
scheduled.text: The engagement survey shows most staff do not feel safe reporting problems.
scheduled.mitigated_text: The speak-up programme launched earlier is starting to shift scores in the right direction.

scheduled.title: Internal audit rates risk actions unsatisfactory
scheduled.text: Internal audit found that a third of risk actions are overdue with no evidence of progress.
scheduled.mitigated_text: Because overdue actions had been tracked and escalated, audit rated the area 'improvement needed' rather than unsatisfactory.

scheduled.title: Major customer gives notice
scheduled.text: A major customer gave notice to move to a competitor at renewal.
scheduled.mitigated_text: The account recovery plan retained part of the business at revised terms.

scheduled.title: Data protection complaint escalated to the regulator
scheduled.text: A customer complaint about misuse of personal data has been referred to the regulator.
scheduled.mitigated_text: Consent records and a data inventory allowed a complete response; the regulator closed the complaint.

scheduled.title: Investment written down
scheduled.text: The investment underperformed sharply and a partial write-down was recognised.
scheduled.mitigated_text: Negotiated protections (staged payments and an earn-out) limited the loss.

scheduled.title: Control prevents a loss
scheduled.text: A control you strengthened detected an error before it caused harm. Management noticed.

scheduled.title: Board commends risk reporting
scheduled.text: The board risk committee praised the quality and candour of recent risk reporting.

scheduled.title: Near miss reported and fixed
scheduled.text: Frontline staff reported a near miss and the hazard was fixed the same day, an early sign that reporting is improving.

scheduled.title: Risk team burnout
scheduled.text: Two analysts are off with stress after months of overload. Deadlines slip.
scheduled.mitigated_text: Because workload had been rebalanced, the team absorbed the peak without anyone going off sick.

scheduled.title: Regulatory fine imposed
scheduled.text: The regulator imposed a fine following its investigation.
scheduled.mitigated_text: Evidence of prompt remediation reduced the penalty substantially.
